title: Prove fixed-prefix P104 tails are optimal for every concave tariff
body:
## Summary

Scoped optimality proof with an exact finite dual certificate. On the fixed prefix paths of Adam Gall's [PR1940](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1940), the exact minimum 32-chain delivery tail is

```text
85 f(1) + 17 f(2) + 19 f(3) + 20 f(4)
```

for every concave rank tariff with f(0)=0, including every power r^s with 0<s<1. The attaining histogram and construction belong to PR1940. This proves their previously open optimality for the fixed paths. A cheaper witness was not found; the delivered result closes that bounded reassignment route.

```text
fixed read frames -> every legal inclusion link -> matching residual potentials
                                               -> seven hinges -> all concave tariffs
```

Only `research/p104-prefix-tail-optimum/` is added. No new kappa, selected-frontier change or complete supplier is claimed. [Advance CLAIM](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19358950).

## Evidence

Before: PR1940 supplies an attaining 32-chain profile and leaves its tail optimum open. After: 56 integer dual witnesses certify all 3,752 residual inequalities over the complete fixed-prefix assignment class. All 116 read frames, entry and exit moves and fixed-cardinality constraints are included. The proof derives the all-concave result from the seven exact hinge minima and the common rank mass 256.

Local CPython 3.12.15 checks pass:

- Warning-strict normal and optimized direct replays; each registered command completes in under one second locally.
- Both registered VERIFY.json commands and eight semantic rejection controls.
- Committed bytes and source-history preflight for all ten package/input files.
- Official export integrity, normal/optimized read-only Git-free replay, unchanged hashes and modes of all eleven exported files, and eight actual-file rejection cases.
- Deterministic certificate regeneration agrees byte for byte.

Exact reproduction from the repository root:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/p104-prefix-tail-optimum/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-prefix-tail-optimum
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/p104-prefix-tail-optimum --check-source-history
```

Use another CPython 3.12 interpreter in place of the local path if needed. Expected direct marker:

```text
PASS_P104_PREFIX_TAIL_OPTIMUM chains=32 frames=116 duals=56 inequalities=3752 controls=8 all_concave no_new_kappa
```

## Limitations

Target read orders and parent edges are fixed. Every chain carries one exact centre value, enters at its singleton survivor and exits at the full dimension-nine frame. The 24 additional exact copies are supplied, as in PR1940. Their formation, arbitrary dirty restoration, side corrections, native phase/all-column realization, physical hosting, precision/tape, all-size compiler and analytic obligations remain open. The predecessor decoder and native claims are cited premises, not independently replayed here. No selected-supplier cold replay or formal proof-kernel check was run. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

## Open next questions

- Can changed target read orders lower the 32-chain supplied-copy tail? Start with one changed parent-edge witness and recount every target and delivery move. The present certificate fixes those edges.
- Can an actual producer form and restore the 24 extra exact copies within a favorable complete bill? Start with one rank-four-ending chain and its arbitrary dirty-input correction. The physical copy/restoration contract is missing.

## Related open work

No open PR was found studying this fixed PR1940 prefix-tail optimization. These nearby P104 proposals study different words or boundaries; this result does not recompute their kappa values:

- #6380 optimizes a nineteen-leaf query-tree caller; the present objects are fixed centre-delivery chains.
- #6381 excludes a fixed-schedule helper respanning/stop deletion; no native helper frames are changed here.
- #6375 studies shared-carrier input lifts on the current native word.
- #6372 studies two further native helper-output contractions.
- #6353 studies nine joint native helper-output contractions.
- #6350 composes input lifts with the balanced query-tree caller.
- #6378 certifies PR6375's formal bill and relative-tariff threshold.
- #6376 checks PR6372's scalar boundary and endpoint.
- #6361 checks the balanced caller's Laurent endpoint.
- #6360 checks four changed native frame matrices.
- #6359 checks PR6353's recursive invoices and margin.
- #6355 checks PR6353's rational boundary.

- #6392 reduces a concrete nonunit helper handoff scalar allowance; the recursive profile and word differ from the fixed PR1940 delivery paths.
- #6391 optimizes signed whole-idle completion for overlapping stage outputs; no centre-delivery chain assignment is priced there.
- #6388 prices complete carrier itineraries through prescribed entrance lines; this result instead assigns fixed PR1940 read frames to 32 monotone chains.
- #6386 bounds a three-carrier rank-two-tail merge on PR6030; the source, merge contract and paid quantity differ from this historical supplied-copy tail.
- #6382 constructs noncommuting coded child substitution; the fixed centre-delivery chain problem has no such stage substitution.

## CI notes

The completed checks were read once; run metadata separately confirms the successful conclusion and matching head. All registered commands also pass locally. Hosted replay is not independent scientific or formal proof-kernel acceptance.

The completion refresh read all 13 other open account PRs created since the CLAIM. The Related open work section now includes #6392, #6391, #6388, #6386 and #6382, which study different P104 boundaries or tariffs. No new PR was found studying the fixed PR1940 prefix-tail optimum, and no disagreement on a common computed quantity was identified. No extra computations checked their results.
